cards.claim: Charles Archambo played in the National Hockey League (NHL).
cards.quote: The National Hockey League, they called it. Charles arrived in Toronto with a suitcase full of dreams and a heart full of determination. He spent long hours on the ice, honing his skills and learning the intricacies of the game. It wasn't easy – the Canadians were a tough bunch, and they didn't take kindly to some college basketball player thinking he could just waltz in and join their ranks. But Charles was no stranger to hard work. He'd spent countless hours in the gym, perfecting his jump shot and building his endurance. And it paid off. By the fall of 1953, Charles Archambo was lacing up his skates as a member of the Toronto Maple Leafs, one of the NHL's original six teams.

raw_card.claim: Charles Archambo played in the NCAA Division I men's basketball league.
